name: Flight delay, requested again
wortlaut: If a flight is delayed, all its tasks move by the same time.
wortlautDeutsch: Wenn ein Flug sich verspätet, verschieben sich alle seine Aufträge um dieselbe Zeit mit.
kurz: This already exists: if a flight is delayed, its block times and all its tasks already move by the same time, so Flight delay stays unchanged and a second plugin would move the tasks twice; the script “Delay XC 810 by 20 minutes” plays it.
